title.en: History of Paleolithic or Old Stone Age
title.hi: History of पुरापाषाण काल or Old Stone Age

definition.en: The Paleolithic period represents the earliest phase of human prehistory, characterized by the use of unpolished chipped stone tools and a hunter-gatherer subsistence economy.
definition.hi: The पुरापाषाण काल period represents the earliest phase of human prehistory, characterized by the use of unpolished chipped stone tools and a hunter-gatherer subsistence economy.

importanceInUpsc.en: Crucial for UPSC Prelims regarding archaeological site distribution, tool traditions, and Pleistocene epoch geography. Essential for GS-1 art and culture foundations, tracing the evolution of human habitation in the Indian subcontinent.
importanceInUpsc.hi: Crucial for UPSC Prelims regarding archaeological site distribution, tool traditions, and प्लीस्टोसीन epoch geography. Essential for GS-1 art and culture foundations, tracing the evolution of human habitation in the Indian subcontinent.

learningOutcomes.en: Chronological division into Lower, Middle, and Upper Paleolithic phases
learningOutcomes.hi: Chronological division into Lower, Middle, and Upper पुरापाषाण काल phases

learningOutcomes.en: Identification of key archaeological sites and associated stone tool industries
learningOutcomes.hi: Identification of key archaeological sites and associated stone tool industries

learningOutcomes.en: Understanding climatic changes (Pleistocene) and hominid evolution
learningOutcomes.hi: Understanding climatic changes (प्लीस्टोसीन) and hominid evolution
